audio.levels: the files carry the designed levels (maximum 400 ms momentary loudness against the Raid's loudest strike, -7.6 LUFS measured on CrownRupture.wav; the Doll strikes this branch's Raid plays reach -7.7 to -8.4 at their call volumes and its ChargeLock foretell -19.0: finales -9.6, cadence -11, show -13, windups -15, cascade parts -15.5, per-shot -17, tolls -19; true peak <= -1 dBTP after the Vorbis round trip), so every cue plays at gain 1; offsets: other players' per-swing and per-shot cues -8 dB, the rolled score's throw -2 dB, a score burst without the Full Melody -2 dB. No pitch variance. Scarlet's own sound set (feat/scarlet-sfx, not on this branch) plays each note's impact at -20.0 LUFS and its foretell at -22.8 (loudest cues -9.6 to -10.4), so after that merge the per-shot cues would sit 3 dB over every Raid impact and the finales level with the Raid's loudest: that merge re-derives the levels role by role and the owner listens again (REWARDS.md#art-and-audio). test_reward_levels_are_pinned_to_the_raid_sound_set_they_were_set_against pins the Raid folder, CrownRupture.wav's hash and the Doll strike calls, so it fails on that merge
audio.wiring: ScarletRewardCues (Terraria-free, linked by the domain tests) holds the files, takes, audiences, voices and leads; ScarletRewardAudio builds SoundStyle only on a client outside the menu with focus and the game unpaused, bounds voices per file (MaxInstances, replace oldest for the local player); every call names the cue's owner and other players' voices are a pool of their own (a ':peer' Identifier, which tML's IsTheSameAs compares before the path): one voice of a per-shot file (replace oldest) and one owner's voices of any other file (ignore new), so another player's windup, finale or playback toll never cuts the local player's, stops on pause and skips a missing file. Timing fixes against the rendered files: the Whip's lash fires as the blade goes live (was 4 ticks early), its brace with the draw-back, the baton's swish on the gesture's first tick, each pipe plays its own OrganShot, a censer brace only when its Grand Pour will sound; the scythe's cues cross from the furthest stroke age seen, so a late sync that steps a peer's stroke back (the sync at 12 after the lash at 15) never rings the lash twice
